items.title: Javier Milei sworn in as President
items.text: Javier Milei took office as President of Argentina on 10 December 2023, launching an orthodox fiscal-monetary adjustment program.

items.title: DNU 70/2023 (mega-decree)
items.text: Emergency decree N° 70/2023 introduced broad deregulation and state reform measures; partially challenged in courts and Congress.

items.title: Ley Bases y Marco Fiscal
items.text: Congress approved the Ley Bases (Law 27.742) after months of debate, enabling fiscal framework, privatizations, and delegated powers.

items.title: RIGI (Régimen de Incentivo para Grandes Inversiones)
items.text: Large Investment Incentive Regime enacted via Ley Bases to attract long-term capital projects with tax and customs benefits.

items.title: IMF Extended Fund Facility — April 2025 augmentation
items.text: IMF Executive Board approved an augmentation of access under the Extended Fund Facility; press materials reference total access on the order of USD 20 billion over the program horizon (staff-level and Board documentation).

items.title: FX band regime (April 2025)
items.text: BCRA announced a widening of the official USD/ARS trading band and a slower crawl, moving from a tight crawling peg toward a band with ~1% monthly crawl (policy communication April 2025).
items.label: Estimate
items.note: Exact band parameters should be cross-checked against BCRA communiqués; crawl cited as policy shift in official statements.

items.title: Crawling peg adjustment (2% to 1%)
items.text: Official FX policy reduced the monthly crawl from about 2% toward 1% as part of disinflation strategy (timeline per BCRA/market commentary).
items.label: Estimate

items.title: Legislative elections (October 2025)
items.text: National legislative elections held 26 October 2025 (half the Chamber of Deputies and one-third of the Senate). Official results published by Cámara Nacional Electoral / Interior.
items.note: Seat counts in the dashboard narrative follow CNE releases; verify final tally on electoral.gob.ar.

items.title: Urban poverty (INDEC, 31 agglomerates)
items.text: INDEC reported 52.9% poverty and 18.1% extreme poverty in H1 2024 (31 urban agglomerates, EPH-based methodology).

items.title: Sovereign default episodes (selected)
items.text: Argentina experienced repeated sovereign debt crises and restructurings including 1827, 1890, 1951, 1982, 1989, 2001, 2014 (selective), and 2020.

items.title: Vaca Muerta shale
items.text: Neuquén Basin unconventional oil & gas production is a structural export and FX earner; pipeline capacity (e.g. Presidente Néstor Kirchner gas pipeline stages) shapes export potential.

items.title: Large external debt service (calendar)
items.text: IMF repurchases, global bond coupons, and private amortizations concentrate in 2025–2027; exact amounts from Ministry of Economy debt reports.
items.label: Estimate
items.note: Payment calendar entries in the site are illustrative unless tied to a published schedule.
